args.body: Hello, thanks for reporting the doors. Our system wrongly logged this as a fridge issue; we've corrected it to a door repair and marked it urgent. Until it's looked at, please try not to slam the doors, as the glass could break. Close them gently and make sure the front door is locked when you're in and out. If any glass cracks, keep clear of it and let us know straight away. We've asked the landlord to approve the repair and will update you by 2024-06-09. Please also reply to the questions we've just sent so we can book a visit.
